source.title: The God Hakkar
source.description:
Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.

Take the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth.  Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.

Be warned, even in this nascent form he will wield unimaginable power and he will resist you with every ounce of his fury.

Defeat him, and place his essence within the Egg of Hakkar.
source.objective:
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

Provided item:
source.progress: Have you defeated the avatar of Hakkar, <name>?  Has his essence yet empowered the egg I gave you?
source.completion:
The essence of Hakkar has been collected!  Even now the Egg stirs with life!  Could the myths of Hakkar be true?

That must not be true, for it is then I fear what Hakkar may do if birthed again.  I will keep this egg safe and be sure it does not fall into evil hands.

Your labors with me are finished, <name>.  You have touched a legend, and your actions may one day change the face of our world.
